title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 30 MARCH 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 30 March 2026. Warm weather conditions prevailing over the island are expected to continue. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Northwestern provinces and in Galle, and Matara districts after 2.00 pm. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
